title: Restore the stock fork damping baseline

applicability.included: Exact standard US2026 YZ450FX original stock suspension.
excluded: Other years, replacement springs/components or aftermarket damping conversions

entry_state: Assembled bike, serviceable stock suspension, exact original adjusters identified.
exit_state: Recorded adjustment and functional checks complete; no internal service performed.
preflight: Stop for leaks, damage, binding or an unidentified adjuster.
Keep the linked diagrams visible to identify distinct controls.
critical_stop_conditions: Adjuster at stop before target, inability to identify stock control, or unresolved setup measurement

required_tools.name: Appropriate damping driver and precision torque tool for1.3Nm

source.review_note: Exact US source author and independent mechanical review accepted this bounded setup companion. Actual work and measurements remain rider records.

steps.title: Inspect both legs
steps.instruction: Support the assembled bike upright. Inspect inner tubes for damage and fork joints for leaks. Apply front brake and compress the fork several times; it must rebound smoothly. Resolve damage/leaks/binding before adjusting.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Record both sides
steps.instruction: Identify bottom rebound and top compression controls from PDF 112–113. Gently turn each toward full hard, counting and saving the original clicks so they can be restored. Never force a stop. Actual total travel can vary from nominal; do not manufacture missing clicks.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Release trapped air
steps.instruction: Raise front wheel securely. Remove each leg bleed screw shown PDF 113 to release internal pressure, then refit each at 1.3 N·m. Keep dirt out and return both screws before setting damping.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Set rebound
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, turn each lower rebound adjuster 8 clicks outward in diagram direction b. Both legs must match. Source nominal range is 0–20 clicks; stop if actual mechanism cannot reach the standard without force.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Set compression
steps.instruction: From gently seated full hard, turn each top compression adjuster 12 clicks outward in diagram direction b. Both legs must match. Source nominal range is 0–20 clicks; never force beyond actual travel.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

steps.title: Verify the baseline
steps.instruction: Lower the bike from its stand. Recheck smooth fork action, both secured bleed screws and matched settings. Record rebound 8/compression 12 clicks out per leg and any unresolved symptoms. This restores damping only; fork height, oil and springs were not changed.
verification: Confirm the described outcome; record actual settings/measurements where requested.
steps.origin: Exact-model OEM illustrated setup companion; setting records and repeatability prompts are workflow adaptations.

completeness: Restore both original fork damping settings, release trapped air and record functional checks. Oil, springs and fork height remain unchanged.

authoring_template.scope: Structure only; values, controls, sequence and sag datum reviewed in this exact manual.
